source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique OOB full SEL erase; neither targeted delete nor pre-test cleanup is equivalent.

source_snapshot.procedure: Reserve 0x0A/0x42, issue 0x0A/0x47 with reservation + CLR + AA, poll same command with 00; also says clear logs before test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Completion, erase status 01, and status query alone must not clear nonempty SEL.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL high-level sel clear; explicit irreversible warning.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Recognizes destructive erase but hides reservation/status details and lacks export/retention.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Requires immutable complete export, explicit isolated-target approval, exact reservation bytes and bounded status polling.
historical_reviews.history: Targeted Delete SEL is separate and less broad.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Routine setup clearing is forbidden; no uncertain retry.

original_test_intent: Validate the full SEL erase transaction and non-destructive status query on an explicitly approved isolated repository after preserving all evidence.
original_method: Reserve the SEL, send ASCII CLR erase initiation 0xAA, then poll status 0x00 until completed.
manual_activity: Repository/forensic owner approves destruction after verifying the complete immutable export and retention policy.
engineer_actions: Own final DUT verdict and forensic escalation

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: sel clear may trigger the feature but hides the raw reservation and status-query checkpoint required by the source.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Only after approval use exact raw reserve/CLR-AA initiation and bounded CLR-00 status polling; never auto-retry.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Source raw operations, scripts and timing preserved; contradictory pre-clear is rejected in Review guidance.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Verify immutable export, initiate one erase, poll without mutation, then prove empty state and retained evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds irreversible authorization, export/hash and no-retry boundary.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Status 01 alone is insufficient without verified export and post-empty repository checks.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Entire audit/fault history is destroyed and has no guaranteed command-level restore.

project_override_considerations: A Redfish/vendor clear action is equivalent only if full export, exact target, completion state and empty-repository evidence match; targeted delete is different coverage.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The core erase flow is coherent, but the generic pre-test instruction to clear SEL would destroy the required nonempty baseline and status-query checkpoint before the test.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Erase semantics are explicit; target/export/approval are execution-readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Removes routine pre-clear from the execution recommendation and makes evidence export, one-shot initiation and non-mutating polling mandatory.
independent_technical_reasoning: Clear SEL is a repository-wide irreversible transition. The initial nonempty inventory must be cryptographically retained, 0xAA may be sent only once, and later 0x00 requests must be shown not to re-initiate erase; timeout or lost response is an escalation, never a retry signal.
